_note: Curated parking for the deep-tier DATA-extra parks (Hart Springs and Lithia Springs). Coordinates marked 'approximate' are not mapped in OpenStreetMap and are placed from the park layout; the OSM-derived ones carry their way id. Capacity and ADA space counts are not published by either county.

lots.name: Day-use lot (springs entrance)
lots.fee: Included in the per-person day-use fee ($5 weekday / $8 weekend and holidays April-September, $3 October-March)
lots.notes: Approximate location just east of the spring, off the entrance drive from 4240 SW 86th Avenue - this lot is not mapped in OpenStreetMap. Pay at the staffed booth on the way in. The park sets a daily capacity and stops admitting new visitors once it is reached, so a shelter or Pavilion A/B reservation is the only guaranteed way in on a hot weekend. Accessible parking is reported by third-party guides but the county publishes no ADA space count.

lots.name: Boat ramp parking (Suwannee River)
lots.notes: At the Hart Springs boat ramp on the Suwannee River (OSM slipway node 3666202908), a short walk downstream of the swimming area. Trailer parking, so it fills on good river days and is not a substitute for the day-use lot.

lots.name: Spring swim-area lot (north)
lots.fee: Included in the $2 per-vehicle entrance fee; the $2 per-person swim band is bought separately at the gate
lots.notes: OSM parking way 312352096, the lot closest to the fenced swimming area. Parking spaces are first come, first served. Because each four-hour swim slot is capped at 200 swimmers, this lot turns over at the 1 p.m./2 p.m. changeover rather than filling for the whole day.

lots.name: Spring swim-area lot (south)
lots.fee: Included in the $2 per-vehicle entrance fee
lots.notes: OSM parking way 312352097, the second lot at the swimming area. First come, first served; no ADA space count is published.

lots.name: Paved lot near the park entrance
lots.fee: Included in the $2 per-vehicle entrance fee
lots.notes: OSM parking way 415385722, an asphalt lot about 150 m east of the swim area toward the entrance station and campground. Useful when the two swim-area lots are full; it is a longer walk to the spring over natural surface.
